entry: The explained 1.2 real-amplitude preview and its H/Z row calculations; no Hilbert-space formalism or general measurement postulate imported.
exit: Identify state/setting/data separately, select a distinguishing setting for the two supplied candidates, and diagnose a simulator-statevector-as-device-readout claim.
assumptions: Known preparations A=H and B=H then Z on initial pair (1,0)
Direct readout versus an additional H followed by readout; no intervening measurement
Constructed independent eight-shot teaching record; re-preparation per hypothetical shot
No random shots, device run, general state-reconstruction protocol or arbitrary-state distinguishability claim
